READ THESE INSTRUCTIONS FIRST
An answer booklet is provided inside this question paper. You should follow the instructions on the front cover
of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.
This syllabus is regulated for use in England, Wales and Northern Ireland as a Cambridge International Level 1/Level 2 Certificate.
This document consists of 3 printed pages and 1 blank page.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–1918
1 How important was the introduction of tanks to the fighting on the Western Front? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were Russia’s military campaigns to the outcome of the war? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–1945
How important was political extremism in causing Germany’s weakness, 1919-23? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant were policies towards businessmen and industrialists in winning support for the
Nazi regime, 1933-39? Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY C:RUSSIA, 1905–1941
How important was Bloody Sunday as a cause of the 1905 Revolution? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Kerensky in the downfall of the Provisional Government? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY D: THE USA, 1919–1941
How important was mass entertainment to the lives of Americans in the 1920s? Explain your answer.
How significant were President Hoover’s attempts to deal with the effects of the Depression? Explain
your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important was improving the lives of the peasants to the consolidation of Communist rule by
1960? Explain your answer.
How significant an issue was Taiwan in Communist China’s foreign relations after 1949? Explain
your answer.
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important was the maintenance of white supremacy to the development of South Africa before
1948? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Nelson Mandela in bringing about an end to white minority rule? Explain your
answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important was the British withdrawal from Palestine as a cause of the war of 1948-49? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant were the actions of Israel in the Palestinian refugee issue after 1948? Explain your
answer. [40]
